subject: general
question:
**Directions: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

As soon he heard / the sound of thunder, / he hid / under the bed.
solution:
The correct answer is '**As soon he heard**' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the phrase ''As soon'' is incorrect.
 
• The phrase ''As soon as'' should be used in place of the phrase ''As soon''.
 
• The given sentence is saying about **someone hiding just after hearing the sound of thunder**.
 
• The **phrase ''As soon as'' **means **immediately after something has happened**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Sentence: ***As soon as he heard** the sound of thunder, he hid under the bed*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में phrase ''As soon'' का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• Phrase ''As soon'' के स्थान पर phrase ''As soon as'' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य कह रहा है कि कोई गड़गड़ाहट की आवाज सुनकर ही छिप गया।
 
• Phrase ''As soon as'' का अर्थ है **कुछ घटित होने के तुरंत बाद**।

 

अतः सही उत्तर option 3 है।

सही वाक्य: *As soon as he heard the sound of thunder, he hid under the bed*.
